Summarise Usability Evidence

Source: R/print.R
usability_summary.Rd

Produces a structured summary of usability evidence, suitable for printing or for passing to downstream reporting functions.

Usage

usability_summary(evidence, config = NULL)

Arguments

evidence

A validated evidence tibble from usability_indicators() or any of the individual assessment functions.

config

A configuration list from usability_config_default(), used for the per-indicator weights in the overall score. If NULL the default configuration is used.

Value

A usability_result list (class "usability_result") with:

study_id

The study identifier from the evidence.

n_vars

Number of unique variable-level locations assessed (the label and Define completeness checks).

overall_score

The weighted mean of the per-indicator pass proportions, using the configuration weights; NA if nothing is applicable.

summary

A tibble with per-indicator pass/fail/warn/na counts and pct_pass (passing rows over applicable rows, excluding "na").

evidence

The original evidence tibble.

Examples

ctx <- suppressMessages(r4subcore::r4sub_run_context(study_id = "STUDY01"))
ev  <- suppressMessages(
  usability_indicators(r4subdata::oncology_metadata, ctx = ctx)
)
#> Error: 'oncology_metadata' is not an exported object from 'namespace:r4subdata'
res <- usability_summary(ev)
#> Error: object 'ev' not found
print(res)
#> Error: object 'res' not found
